title: Sleep and Study Habits of University Students
consentTextExcerpt: You will receive $1 for completing this survey. If responses cannot be verified, compensation may not be issued.
rulesText: Don't pay responses finished in under 4 minutes. Don't pay anyone who fails the attention check on Q14 (correct answer: Strongly disagree). Don't pay if the hidden field is filled. Only one payment per email address — keep the earliest. Participants must be 18–30. Send for review if age and date of birth don't match, or if more than 25 responses arrive within one minute.
